Events refer to that table; repeats compress exact duplicates only. canonical_json_text is a record's decoded JSON, with no added facts. current_state is the current state, not a replacement for evidence in history. An empty notebook does NOT mean that no evidence has been observed. Your reasoning must use evidence already in history as well as newly read records.

Exiting room 3 clears the supplied transcript. Each API request is stateless; no previous response or conversation ID is reused. Only the latest notebook survives: exactly eight printable ASCII lines, at most96 bytes per line. Notes must be your own compact facts and source IDs inferred from observed evidence. There is no external memory, filesystem, network or reference solver. After that wipe, use only the notebook and newly available public evidence. Person order is I,N,V,S; aliases are ash,birch,cedar,dusk; their relationship is episode-specific. Complete room objectives before exit_room; Osmosis ends with settle after eight rounds.
